--CREATE VIEW CALENDAR--

CREATE VIEW gold.calendar
AS 
SELECT 
      *
FROM OPENROWSET(
               BULK 'https://awstoragedatalakethobani.blob.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
               FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS Query_Calendar
